cases.name: Olivia Daryl Taylor
cases.about:
She was the youngest of her siblings, born and raised in Putnam County, involved in ROTC, and dreamed of being a medic in the Army one day. Her mother Stephanie Harness said, “She’s just my favorite person. She really was,” said Harness. “She’s just so lovable. She just was, you know? Just something about her. She’s just so easy to love. She just showed so much love.”

Her obituary said, "Olivia was a student attending Upperman High School in Baxter, TN where she was a member of the Wrestling Team and the ROTC. She loved baking, sewing, singing, being an artist and playing the ukulele."
cases.narrative:
On 10/27/2022, her body was found by found by Putnam County Road Department employees in a wooded area east of Cookeville.

According to the press release, Carter allegedly told investigators that he had “supplied and given Taylor with illegal substances that caused her death.” Investigators think Taylor overdosed on fentanyl and died, but a toxicology report is still being run.
